mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, content, cover, tag_id, view_count, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count, share_count, hot_score, status, is_top, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{cover}, #{tagId}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{hotScore}, #{status}, #{isTop}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.user_name, u.user_avatar, t.name AS tag_name FROM post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN post_tag t ON t.id = p.tag_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET hot_score = (view_count * 1 + like_count * 3 + favorite_count * 2 + comment_count * 4 + share_count * 5) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT t.name as tag, COUNT(*) as count FROM post p JOIN post_tag t ON t.id = p.tag_id WHERE p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.tag_id, t.name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM post WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
